run_clang_tidy_on_files: run clang-tidy against one or more C++ source files in parallel
run_clang_tidy_with_fix: run clang-tidy with the --fix flag to automatically apply suggested fixes to C++ files
run_clang_tidy_parallel_jobs: run clang-tidy across multiple files using a specified number of parallel CPU jobs
run_clang_tidy_custom_binary: run clang-tidy using a custom binary path set via the CLANG_TIDY environment variable
run_clang_tidy_with_clang_complete: run clang-tidy using include paths parsed from the .clang_complete configuration file
